power.jaymospowers.web.desc: Swing on one web or two. Both webs out + Sneak: slingshot (hold Jump to draw). Hold Jump in mid-air: web wings.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_1: Hold: main-hand web swing (release on the upswing for a boost)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_2: Hold: off-hand web (empty off hand) / else Web Zip
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_3: Hold to charge: web blast (splash Slowness III + cobwebs)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_4: Hold: Yank and hold a creature on a web lead (big ones pull you)
